verdict.rationale: Ramp documents employee reimbursements paid "in two days or less in their local currency" across 70+ countries, with mileage calculation. Employees can submit and request reimbursements via the CLI (reimbursements list/pending/submit) and MCP, and the sandbox models a reimbursement lifecycle through to "paid". Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that payout is by direct deposit/bank transfer, documented employee-facing status tracking from submission to payout, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the two-day speed.
